test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language. ALMIRAH is written as HRRMUCI and COMPANY is written as JURTDPZ. How will JUNGLEE be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:​

ALMIRAH is written as HRRMUCI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5225a127af4bed8814ef6bf6cdf601b95cfa79316960111fea3334bd2d1f27fb.png] 

And,

COMPANY is written as JURTDPZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a1d3015ac8ed119bb29e20f8815aa8ec753831db76d0ce7e7350df25677756c.png] 

Similarly,

'**JUNGLEE**' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23b6c344531ea7a75b20157ad94a524c2a71a7fb36775cb0159d2571e6ba9efb.png] 

Hence, 'JUNGLEE' is coded as "**QASKOGF**".
